title: Fiberwise coinitiality for left fibrations over products
statement:
Use quasicategories, simplicial functors, coherent functor categories, mapping spaces and constant diagrams of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and left fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Fix a universe $\mathcal V$ and $\mathcal V$-small quasicategories $Z,C,D,X,Y$. Let $g:C\to D$, let $p:X\to Z\times C$ and $q:Y\to Z\times D$ be left fibrations, and let $h:X\to Y$ be a simplicial map satisfying $qh=(1_Z\times g)p$. For a vertex $z\in Z$, put $X_z=X\times_Z\{z\}$ and $Y_z=Y\times_Z\{z\}$, using the first-coordinate projections; write $h_z:X_z\to Y_z$ for the induced map. Suppose that, for each $z$, every quasicategory $E$ in any containing universe, every diagram $F:Y_z^{\mathrm{op}}\to E$ and every vertex $e\in E$, restriction induces an equivalence
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(Y_z^{\mathrm{op}},E)}(F,\Delta e)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(X_z^{\mathrm{op}},E)}(Fh_z^{\mathrm{op}},\Delta e).$$
Then, for every such $E$, every diagram $F:Y^{\mathrm{op}}\to E$ and every $e\in E$, restriction induces an equivalence
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(Y^{\mathrm{op}},E)}(F,\Delta e)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(X^{\mathrm{op}},E)}(Fh^{\mathrm{op}},\Delta e).$$
These are the actual restriction comparisons, natural in $F,e$ and compatible with coherent postcomposition. No colimit-existence hypothesis on $E$ is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 5.6.7, printed pp. 240-241 (PDF pp. 255-256), July 30 2026 revision. Cofinal there means opposite-final by Definition 4.4.13. The intrinsic cocone-space formulation is the standard finality characterization: HTT Proposition 4.1.1.8, or Cisinski Theorem 6.4.5 with space-valued cocone tests. Read online; archival copy WANTED. No Stacks tag states this quasicategorical theorem.
